description: This file contains Redux Saga generator functions for handling side effects such as API calls, user authentication, data synchronization, and state updates in a React-Redux application. It defines sagas for login, logout, fetching notes, categories, settings, and syncing data, as well as a root saga to coordinate these effects.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Generator function to handle user login, either via demo mode or API call, and dispatches success or error actions.

methods.name: logoutUser
methods.description: Generator function to handle user logout, either via demo mode or API call, and dispatches success actions.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Generator function to fetch notes from API or demo data, then dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: fetchCategories
methods.description: Generator function to fetch categories from API or demo data, then dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: fetchSettings
methods.description: Generator function to fetch settings from API and dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: syncData
methods.description: Generator function to sync data payload to API or demo storage, then dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: syncSettings
methods.description: Generator function to save current settings state.

methods.name: rootSaga
methods.description: Main saga that listens for specific actions and triggers corresponding worker sagas.
